title: Neural Radiance Field Image Refinement through End‐to‐End Sampling Point Optimization
abstract: Neural radiance field (NeRF), capable of synthesizing high‐quality novel viewpoint images, suffers from issues like artifact occurrence due to its fixed sampling points during rendering. This study proposes a method that optimizes sampling points to reduce artifacts and produce more detailed images. © 2024 Institute of Electrical Engineers of Japan and Wiley Periodicals LLC.
